Pashchim bangal ka nam badalkar 'pashchim bang' karne ka prastav kyon laya gaya hai? 1947 ke vibhajan se iska kya sanbandh hai? TMC ke 'bangla' nam ke prastav ko kendr ne kyon kharij kiya tha? sath hi, kolkata ki sarkon ke nam badalne ke pichhe bhajpa ki kya yojna hai? janie is puri kavayad ka itihas aur rajnitik mahatva.
